Thanks for the flag — reviewed with bookkeeping this morning. Summary below and proposed next steps.

What happened:
- The escrow reference (ESC-9987) arrived on the bank file but our auto-apply routine expects the invoice reference number (INV-2025-1101 / -1102). Because the reference didn't match the invoice keys, the payment went to the suspense clearing account (4100-SUSP).
- The amount on the remittance matches the two invoices in total, but VAT was included as a separate line instead of being embedded in each invoice in StellarNet's statement.

Proposed allocation (can be applied manually):
- Debit 4100-SUSP USD 72,450.00
- Credit AR INV-2025-1101 USD 45,000.00
- Credit AR INV-2025-1102 USD 25,000.00
- Credit VAT payable USD 2,450.00

If you prefer we can:
A) Apply exactly as above and issue a short payment confirmation showing the invoices applied and VAT line, or
B) Create a small credit memo to reconcile if StellarNet wants VAT applied differently across the two invoices.

Needed from StellarNet to close:
- Bank trace (ach/bank reference) to confirm clearing time (if you want us to back-date allocation to the bank clearing date)
- Confirmation if you want VAT split across invoices or left as standalone VAT line

I've attached an allocation_proposal.csv and a brief export of the bank trace we have on file (bank_trace_1120.txt). If this looks good I'll execute the manual posting later today and send a cleared receipt.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Accounting Lead, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
